title: Definition
text: $$\sin(2\pi)$$ is the y-coordinate of the point on the circle that lies on the positive horizontal axis

title: Coordinate
text: The y-coordinate of the point on the unit circle with angle $$2\pi$$ is $$0$$.\n##figure2.gif##

figureAlts.figure2.gif: Diagram of the coordinate (cosine of 2 pi, sine of 2 pi) on the unit circle with an arrow indicating that 2 pi is one revolution around the circle.
